guidelines.title: To ensure your scholarship application is as strong as possible, please keep these important points in mind before you finalize and submit:
guidelines.accuracy: Accuracy and Completeness: Double-check that all the information you've provided is accurate and complete. Incomplete or inaccurate details can lead to delays or disqualification.
guidelines.documents: Required Documents: Make sure you have gathered and uploaded all necessary supporting documents as specified. Ensure they are in the correct format and clearly legible.
guidelines.proofread: Proofread Thoroughly: Before hitting submit, proofread your entire application for any spelling or grammatical errors. A polished application demonstrates attention to detail.
guidelines.deadlines: Adhere to Deadlines: Be mindful of the submission deadline. Late applications are typically not considered.
guidelines.instructions: Follow Instructions Precisely: Carefully review and follow all instructions provided for the application form and any accompanying materials.

guidelines.title: Scholarship Provider Guidelines
guidelines.description: Thank you for your interest in listing your scholarship. To ensure the inclusion of your scholarship on our platform, please ensure that it adheres to the following guidelines:

guidelines.1: You need to subscribe to a package to be able to submit scholarships and use the AI support services of our platform.
guidelines.2: Students should not be prompted to provide their social security number during the application process.
guidelines.3: Students must not be prompted to provide credit card information during the application process.
guidelines.4: The scholarship must be associated with a legitimate.
guidelines.5: The scholarship should offer a reasonable award, commensurate with the amount of effort required from applicants.
guidelines.6: The scholarship rules must be clearly displayed, outlining all eligibility criteria, deadlines, required materials, and the process for selecting scholarship winners or judging criteria.
guidelines.7: The scholarship listing must not be a duplicate of any scholarships already listed. Please retain all information received from system upon successful completion of the listing process.
guidelines.8: Contact information, including address, phone number, and email, must be easily accessible to students for any inquiries regarding the scholarship and its rules.
guidelines.9: The scholarship provider should provide us with a contact email address that uses the organization's domain name (e.g., admin@examplescholarship.org). It is the responsibility of the scholarship provider to ensure that they can be reached by us.

requiredInformation.title: Required Information to Submit a Scholarship
requiredInformation.scholarshipProviderInformationDescriptio: In order for your scholarship to be listed, we require the mailing address, phone number, contact name, email address, and website URL of your organization. Please note that this information will be used exclusively for internal purposes, although specific fields on the online submission form are mandatory.
requiredInformation.scholarshipInformationDescription: To best serve our site’s users and providers, all scholarships listed must:

scholarshipInformationList.1: Provide a descriptive summary of the award
scholarshipInformationList.2: Include a scholarship title, deadline date, value of the scholarships and number of awards available
scholarshipInformationList.3: Indicate the type of student the scholarship is targeting and be sure to review and edit all filterable criteria to ensure only those students who will qualify for the scholarship being offered will be presented with the scholarship.
